title: Serra da Estrela Natural Park
intro: Serra da Estrela Natural Park ( Portuguese: Parque Natural da Serra da Estrela ) is in Central Portugal. It contains mainland Portugal's tallest mountain peak and the country's only ski resort.

sections.title: Overview
sections.html: Serra da Estrela Natural Park (Portuguese: Parque Natural da Serra da Estrela) is in Central Portugal. It contains mainland Portugal's tallest mountain peak and the country's only ski resort.

sections.title: Understand
sections.html:
The park is situated in the largest mountain range in Portugal, the Serra da Estrela (SEH-rruh duh sh-TRIHL-uh, /ˈsɛ.ʁɐ dɐ ʃ.ˈtɾe.ɫɐ/, "Star Mountain"), and is the source of the rivers Mondego, Zêzere (tributary of the Tagus), and Alva. The park is the largest natural conservation area in Portugal and occupies about 1,000 km2 (390 sq mi). More than half of its area is located above an altitude of 700 m (2,300 ft). At 1,993 m (6,539 ft), it contains the highest peak in Continental Portugal (named Torre) and a ski resort.

Throughout the park, a traditional mountain economy is practised, centred on agriculture, raising sheep and goats, and the manufacture of Queijo Serra da Estrela cheese. The craftsmanship of the region is expressed in basket work using chestnut and wicker, weaving, embroidered cotton and smoked produce.

The park's land falls within the former provinces of Beira Alta and Beira Baixa in six municipalities: Celorico da Beira, Covilhã, Gouveia, Guarda, Manteigas, and Seia.

sections.title: Flora and fauna
sections.html: The region is known for the cão da Serra da Estrela dog, one of the oldest breeds on the Iberian Peninsula. They are bred to guard flocks of ovelha da Serra da Estrela sheep that produce the queijo da serra da Estrela cheese.

sections.title: Get in
sections.html:
• The A 23 motorway (Autoestrada da Beira Interior) serves nearby Covilhã with access from Torres Novas, Entroncamento, Abrantes, Castelo Branco, Fundão, and Guarda.
  • The A 25 motorway (Autoestrada das Beiras Litoral e Alta, IP 5) serves nearby Celorico da Beira and Guarda with access from Ílhavo, Viseu, and Vilar Formoso (at the Spanish border).
  • N 16 skirts the park to the northeast and provides access from Aveiro, Viseu, and the border town of Vilar Formoso.
  • N 17 skirts the northwestern edge of the park, serving Seia, Gouveia, and Celorico da Beira with access from Coimbra.

sections.title: Fees and permits
sections.html: There are no fees or permits required to visit the park.

sections.title: Get around
sections.html: Several minor national roads cross the park, skirt its edges, or connect with surrounding towns, including N 230, N 231, N 232, N 338, and N 339.

sections.title: See
sections.html:
• Torre (N 338-1). At 1,993 m (6,539 ft), Torre is continental Portugal's tallest mountain peak. A 7 m (23 ft) man-made tower on the site ostensibly brings the pinnacle's total height to 2,000 m (6,600 ft). The mountaintop is accessible by car via a paved road. (updated Jun 2021)
  • Capela de Nossa Senhora do Ar (Capela da Torre, Chapel of Our Lady of the Air) (N 338-1). This chapel is located at the former base of the Portuguese Air Force's Squadron 13 of the Alert, Detection, and Interception Conduct Group. It was built in 1962 and was reopened in 2007 after decades of abandonment. (updated Jun 2021)

sections.title: Do
sections.html:
• Estância de Esqui da Serra da Estrela (Vodafone Ski Resort) (on N 399 road in Loriga, Seia), ☏ +351 275 094 779, estancia@turistrela.pt. At an elevation of 2,000 m (6,600 ft), this is Portugal's only ski resort. They have a skiing and snowboarding school. Although located in Seia municipality, the resort's main gateway is the village of Penhas da Saúde in Covilhã. (updated May 2021)
  • Estrela Ebike Ebike Rental, Vale de Manteigas S/N, ☏ +351 967244505, info@estrelaebike.pt. 8AM-18PM. Ebike guided or autoguided tours by the mountain. €40. (updated Dec 2022)

sections.title: Buy
sections.html: • Centro Comercial da Torre. A small, slightly run-down shopping centre with multiple vendors at the tip top of Portugal. Look for regional products, including queijo Serra da Estrela cheese, presunto ham, and woollen goods. (updated May 2021)

sections.title: Eat
sections.html:
• Lenda Viriato, Rua de Santo Aleixo 16, Unhais da Serra, Covilhã (behind the church), ☏ +351 275 971 252, contacto@lendaviriato.pt. Tue–Fri 19:30–22:00, Sat Sun 12:30–15:00 & 19:30–22:00, closed Mon. The building was constructed in 1905 as the village's wood fire oven. It was converted into a restaurant in 2009 and given a medieval theme based on the legend of Viriato, the leader of the Lusitano people, ancestors of the Portuguese. Their recommended dishes include kid goat, veal, and cod with corn bread. (updated May 2021)
  • O Mirante Da Estrela, Rua do Comércio 60, Sabugueiro, Seia, ☏ +351 969 089 750. Thu–Tue 12:00–16:00, closed Wed. Cosy place with traditional cooking and great mountain views. (updated May 2021)
  • Restaurante O Olival, N 232, Nº 2, Manteigas, ☏ +351 275 982 354, msmanteigas@gmail.com. Mon Tue Thu–Sat 12:00–14:30 & 19:00–21:00, Sun 12:00–14:30, closed Wed. The building and decor may be modern, but the food is authentic and traditional. €8-15. (updated May 2021)

sections.title: Lodging
sections.html:
• Casa Lagar da Alagoa, N 232, km 73, Vale de Amoreira, Manteigas, ☏ +351 275 487 024, geral@casa-lagar-alagoa.com. Check-in: 14:00–21:00, check-out: 07:00–12:00. This quaint, rustic three-star, 9-room hotel in a country home is run by a friendly older couple. Amenities include a bar, a garden, free Wi-Fi in the main lounge, free breakfast, and free parking. €54-107. (updated May 2021)
  • Luna Hotel Serra da Estrela, N 339, Penhas da Saúde, Covilhã, ☏ +351 275 310 300, serradaestrela@lunahoteis.com. Check-in: 16:00, check-out: 12:00. This four-star, 80-room hotel boasts a heated indoor pool, an outdoor pool, a games room with billiards table, a tennis court, children's activities, and a "medieval" restaurant. Amenities include room service, free Wi-Fi, free breakfast, and free parking. €44-112. (updated May 2021)
  • Pousada da Juventude Serra da Estrela (Serra da Estrela Youth Hostel), Estrada Nacional 339, Penhas da Saúde, Serra da Estrela, Covilhã, ☏ +351 275 335 375, geral@pjserradaestrela.pt. Check-in: 18:00, check-out: 12:00. €32-48. (updated May 2021)

sections.title: Camping
sections.html:
• Parque de Campismo Curral do Negro, Sítio do Curral do Negro, Gouveia, ☏ +351 924 397 711, geral@curraldonegro.pt.  (updated May 2021)
  • Parque de Campismo do Pião (Camping Pião), N 339, Covilhã, ☏ +351 275 314 312, campismo.piao@hotmail.com. This campground has a snack bar, a cookout area, bicycle rentals, a swimming pool, toilets, and showers. The property has bungalows and mobile homes. (updated May 2021)
  • Parque de Campismo Rossio de Valhelhas (Valhelhas Camping), N 232, Valhelhas, Guarda, ☏ + 351 927 464 301, geral@valhelhascamping.com. Campground on the River Zêzere. (updated May 2021)
